problem: Importing zone.js does not itself establish zoneful Angular change detection at current peers. The lab must verify the injected NgZone's execution mode before signalling readiness.
design: waitReady(expectedZoneless) derives expected mode from the actual matrix request runtime field, rejects any runtime label other than zoneful/zoneless, reads window.__lab.zoneMode only after declared readiness, and validates both that self-reported label and the actual NgZone membership observation against the request. It returns the validated observation; both browser execution entry points preserve per-engine zoneModeObservations with line, requested runtime and observed values. Existing fixture elements, actions, styling and the applicationProviders public-provider choice are unchanged.

Full browser applicability is untested. Existing 21.2.23 peer-only probe used module providers for its zoneful observation; applicationProviders is the documented variant and remains to be exercised.
